title: Microalgae Octapeptide IIAVEAGC Alleviates Oxidative Stress and Neurotoxicity in 6-OHDA-Induced SH-SY5Y Cells by Regulating the Nrf2/HO-1and Jak2/Stat3 Pathways.
authors: Liu, Yi; Lin, Liyuan; Zheng, Haiyan; Huang, Huixue; Qian, Zhong-Ji
one_liner_zh: 该文研究微藻八肽IEC对氧化应激和神经毒性的保护作用，涉及分子动力学模拟和分子对接，但对象为肽-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与TF-DNA课题无关。
abstract: Neurodegenerative diseases are characterized by the progressive loss of selectively vulnerable populations of neurons, and many factors are involved in its causes. Neurotoxicity and oxidative stress, are the main related factors. The octapeptide Ile-Ile-Ala-Val-Glu-Ala-Gly-Cys (IEC) was identified from the microalgae Isochrysis zhanjiangensis and exhibited potential anti-oxidative stress activity. In this study, the stability of alpha-synaptic protein binding to IEC was modeled using molecular dynamics, and the results indicated binding stabilization within 60 ns. Oxidative stress in neurons is the major cause of alpha-synaptic protein congestion. Therefore, we next evaluated the protective effects of IEC against oxidative stress and neurotoxicity in 6-ohdainduced Parkinson's disease (PD) model SH-SY5Y cells in vitro. In oxidative stress, IEC appeared to increase the expression of the antioxidant enzymes HO-1 and GPX through the antioxidant pathway of Nrf2, and molecular docking of IEC with Nrf2 and GPX could generate hydrogen bonds. Regarding apoptosis, IEC protected cells by increasing the Bcl-2/Bax ratio, inhibiting the caspase cascade, acting on p53, and modulating the Jak2/Stat3 pathway. The results indicated that IEC exerted neuroprotective effects through the inhibition of alpha-synaptic protein aggregation and antioxidant activity. Therefore, microalgal peptides have promising applications in the prevention and treatment of neurodegenerative diseases.
abstract_zh: 神经退行性疾病以选择性易感神经元群体的进行性丧失为特征，其病因涉及多种因素，其中神经毒性和氧化应激是主要相关因素。从微藻湛江等鞭金藻（Isochrysis zhanjiangensis）中鉴定出的八肽Ile-Ile-Ala-Val-Glu-Ala-Gly-Cys（IEC）显示出潜在的抗氧化应激活性。本研究利用分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟了α-突触核蛋白与IEC结合的稳定性，结果表明在60 ns内结合趋于稳定。神经元中的氧化应激是α-突触核蛋白聚集的主要原因。因此，我们进一步在6-羟基多巴胺诱导的帕金森病（Parkinson's disease, PD）模型SH-SY5Y细胞中评估了IEC对氧化应激和神经毒性的保护作用。在氧化应激条件下，IEC似乎通过Nrf2抗氧化通路增加抗氧化酶HO-1和GPX的表达，且IEC与Nrf2和GPX的分子对接可形成氢键。在细胞凋亡方面，IEC通过提高Bcl-2/Bax比值、抑制caspase级联反应、作用于p53以及调节Jak2/Stat3通路来保护细胞。结果表明，IEC通过抑制α-突触核蛋白聚集和发挥抗氧化活性产生神经保护作用。因此，微藻肽在神经退行性疾病的预防和治疗中具有广阔的应用前景。
